status: FROZEN; research protocol artifact, not a production schema

sources.canonicalityNote: Locked official single-file FY2024 request source; this profile does not change the source lock.

preflight.textAvailability: native text observed; engine limitations must remain distinct from source absence
preflight.geometryAvailability: available when emitted by an authorized observation method; optional, not a prerequisite for every observation
targetGrammarClasses: remarks-side nested structures as separate structural grammar
excludedGrammarClasses: cover/TOC/summary as semantic context for ledger observations
preflight.organizationScope: source-visible anchors only; do not infer across grammar boundaries
unitScopes: outer-ledger opening declaration （単位：千円） applies only to the evidenced outer structure
a nested/local declaration, if present, is bounded to its own framed structure
preflight.hierarchyPattern: outer ledger plus remarks-side nested structures; preserve distinct nodes and edges
preflight.continuationBehavior: not authorized across pages without later amendment supported by direct evidence
preflight.embeddedStructures: remarks-side boxes/tables are structurally distinct and must not be flattened into outer-ledger rows
ambiguityHazards: context crossing a page or grammar boundary

allowed: source-native observations in an identified partition
same-page context within the same outer grid
separate structural observation of nested material
prohibited: semantic candidate derivation in this profile
flattening nested material into an outer row
using landing-page provenance as ledger semantics

prohibitedCandidateDerivationRules: MOF feedback into request-side extraction or normalization
arithmetic reconstruction of an unprinted parent amount
nested-unit promotion to the outer ledger
financialOwnershipRule: Record source-observed alignment and containment only. Do not promote child values to a parent, sum descendants, reconstruct arithmetic, or treat a blank as zero.

contextPermissions.samePage: allowed only within the identified outer grid or the same bounded nested structure

stopFailureRules: ambiguous grammar or unit/context scope is preserved as ambiguous
a needed cross-page inference requires amendment rather than silent relaxation
observationStateVocabulary: Refer unchanged to the Frozen Canonical Semantic Extraction Protocol: observed_value, observed_blank, not_present_on_node, not_applicable, not_inspected, unknown, ambiguous, not_extracted, not_created.
unresolvedNonblockingItems: No general cross-page continuation rule is evidenced; it is prohibited rather than inferred.
Nested local-unit behavior must be recorded per bounded structure when encountered.

freezeMetadata.freezeCommitNote: Recorded by Git history after creation; no self-referential amend loop.
